resolutions.finding: The non-fork decision path still instructs an immediate AskUserQuestion
resolutions.pushback: still applies — verified at :640, the classification-table clause read 'otherwise surface 2–4 concrete options via **AskUserQuestion**', a live imperative competing with 3b.5
resolutions.classification: trivial fix (obvious-fix lane; previewed at triage, ratified by user 'go')
resolutions.action: Clause replaced with a pure handoff to Step 3b.5: construct 2–4 concrete options FOR THE PROSE BRIEFING; no prompt fires at classification; AskUserQuestion exists only as post-discussion closure per 3b.5. Added generated-body negative tests rejecting any pre-3b.5 'options via AskUserQuestion' imperative plus a positive 'post-discussion closure' marker.

resolutions.finding: Two unvalidated single-line fields can still forge report grammar
resolutions.pushback: still applies — findings[].file and recommendation_options[].label were interpolated outside blockquote containment with no line-shape check; both reproductions confirmed
resolutions.classification: trivial fix (obvious-fix lane; previewed — extends the chat-ratified 'fail loud' policy from the fresh iter-2 walk to the complete slot set)
resolutions.action: One checked helper (requireSingleLine, rejecting CR and LF, naming the exact slot) now covers the COMPLETE set: finding title and file, recommendation_options[].label, stale_suppressed[].title/evidence, reviewer_class, depth; option bodies keep collapse-to-space. Table-driven test enumerates every slot (7 slots × LF + CR case) plus the reviewer's two end-to-end forging reproductions. Spec letter extended to the complete slot set naming CR-or-LF.

resolutions.finding: Internal reports ignore the emit's change field despite the canonical header rule
resolutions.pushback: still applies — NormalizedReviewPass dropped the internal change; the renderer printed ctx.change (the CLI argument) for both genres
resolutions.classification: trivial fix (obvious-fix lane; previewed — design D2b's stated rule is implemented, not revised)
resolutions.action: The internal change is preserved through normalization, validated against the change being rendered (mismatch fails loud naming both values — never a silent relabel), and the header renders the validated emit value. Mismatch fixture added; matching-change render asserted byte-identical. Spec letter and a new deterministic-spine-drift scenario name the change-source rule.

resolutions.finding: The shipped external prompt block is not the verbatim block in its delta
resolutions.pushback: still applies — the delta carried the compact form (631 chars) while the shipped template carries the parenthetical form (1098 chars); this review itself ran on the shipped variant
resolutions.classification: trivial fix (obvious-fix lane; previewed — the SHIPPED block is the intended one, demonstrated working by this very review's parse)
resolutions.action: The shipped template's inner output-format block extracted (un-escaped) and spliced byte-for-byte into the delta's MODIFIED requirement, replacing the compact form. Added a spec-to-template extraction assertion: the delta's inner block must byte-equal the block extracted from review-external.ts's prompt-template reference (guards until archive; parity covers template-to-surface thereafter). Validate --strict and fingerprints 18/18 re-verified after the splice.

resolutions.finding: Gate-computation failures are silently rendered as an ungated tail
resolutions.pushback: still applies — buildReportContext's blanket catch swallowed loadChangeContext/formatChangeStatus exceptions into the minimal-tail path
resolutions.classification: trivial fix (obvious-fix lane; previewed — the fail-loud policy already governs this surface)
resolutions.action: The catch-all replaced with a rethrow: tail-computation failures propagate as a clean render failure naming the change and cause; the ungated path (computed absence, no throw) is untouched and keeps its golden. Broken-schema thrown-tail test added, distinct from the ungated golden. Spec letter now states the ungated tail is a COMPUTED absence, never an error mask.

resolutions.finding: Deterministic spine values are required but never checked
resolutions.pushback: still applies — strict validation checked spine fields for string type only; kind:'workflow' or a drifted final_assessment passed
resolutions.classification: trivial fix (obvious-fix lane; previewed — the values were already normative in the review capability's deltas; this closes the render-side check)
resolutions.action: Validation now enforces command === 'review', kind === 'editorial', reviewer_class membership, final_assessment equal to the scorecard-derived counts sentence (or 'No findings.'), and next_recommended equal to the findings-dependent self/report pointer — ordered after the scorecard-rollup check so a mismatched cell keeps error primacy. Six semantic-mismatch tests added; three renderer-test fixtures and the status-report helper updated to carry the deterministic values (fixtures conformed, checks never weakened). Spec letter gained the spine-semantics sentences and a drift scenario.

resolutions.finding: Malformed dates and empty descriptions pass the strict external parser
resolutions.pushback: still applies — malformed was implemented as empty-only; '**Date**: banana' rendered as a reviewer date
resolutions.action: Date validated against YYYY-MM-DD with a UTC calendar round-trip (banana and 2026-02-30 both reject naming the field); Description requires a nonblank body after trimming (rejects naming the finding). Four rejection tests added. Spec letter's malformed clause now names the real-calendar-date and nonblank-Description rules.

resolutions.finding: Reviewer and Date labels inside a Description are misparsed as header metadata
resolutions.pushback: still applies — Reviewer/Date recognition ran globally before the finding-body branch; field-shaped prose in a body failed a valid file
resolutions.action: Header-metadata parsing is scoped to the pre-severity header region (recognized only while no section is open — coincides with 'before the first severity heading' on every conformant file since the shape gate makes the first ## heading a severity one); non-heading lines after **Description**: are verbatim body. Fixture with unfenced Reviewer-shaped prose inside a Description accepted as body text. Spec letter names the header-region scoping.

resolutions.finding: Fence tracking does not implement Markdown fence boundaries
resolutions.pushback: still applies — fence state toggled on any column-0 triple run; a three-backtick line closed a four-backtick fence
resolutions.action: createFenceTracker(): remembers delimiter character and length, closes only on same character at ≥ opening length with only trailing whitespace, accepts up to three leading spaces both ends, rejects backtick-in-info-string openers; shared by BOTH the strict external parser and lenient trail counting so ordinal/count parsing cannot disagree. Two fence tests added (four-backtick containing triple stays open; indented fence with ## Notes inside stays body). Spec letter names the CommonMark fence rule.

resolutions.finding: Report error paths write a stray newline to stdout
resolutions.pushback: still applies — the shared status action catch executed console.log() before the ora error on every --report rejection
resolutions.action: Spacing routed to stderr (console.error; ora already writes stderr) — report failures leave stdout empty. Empty-stdout assertions added for ALL of the reviewer's named cases: json-conflict, pre-boundary, malformed-external, non-renderable-genre, plus zero-renderable and --report-without---change.

post_state: Build green; 1817 tests green (1787 at review time + 26 hardening additions + the extraction assertion + the decision-lane negative tests + the CLI empty-stdout test, net of fixture consolidation); strict validation passes; fingerprints 18/18; surface refreshed via update --force
final_assessment: All 10 external system iter-1 findings resolved (4 CRITICAL, 4 WARNING, 2 SUGGESTION) — the triage opened with the full ten-item obvious-fix lane preview and the user's 'go' ratified the lane wholesale; no decision forks. The reviewer's residual pattern (enumerated unsafe slots instead of the whole grammar-source boundary; fidelity tests comparing generated-to-source instead of delta-to-template) drove the two structural fixes: the complete single-line slot set behind one checked helper, and the spec-to-template extraction assertion. The five renderer strictness holes (change source, thrown tail, spine semantics, date/description, header region, fences) all closed fail-loud with the delta letter extended to match; fixtures conformed to the stricter checks, no check weakened, no golden changed.
